title: Problem Definition Schema
description: Schema for validating problem definition JSON files, typically used for coding challenges.

difficulty.description: The difficulty level of the problem.

description.description: A detailed description of the problem.

examples.description: Examples demonstrating the problem's input and expected output.

input.description: String representation of the example input.

output.description: String representation of the example output.

input.description: Defines the structure and types of the input parameters.

type.description: The data type of the input parameter.

output.description: Indicates if this input parameter is part of the output. This is only applicable for problems where the input is modified in-place and needs to be evaluated with the expected output.

childType.description: Required if 'type' is 'array', defines the type of array elements.

type.description: The data type of the array elements.

description.description: A description of the input parameter.

output.description: Defines the structure and type of the expected output.

type.description: The data type of the output.

functionName.description: The name of the function to be implemented.

executionMode.description: How the solution's output should be captured. If the execution mode is 'in-place', the input parameters may be modified, and the output will be derived from the modified inputs.

comparisonMode.description: How the actual output should be compared to the expected output.

testCases.description: A list of test cases for the problem.

input.description: The input values for the test case, matching the 'input' schema.

expected.description: The expected output for the test case.

solutions.description: Various solutions for the problem, potentially with different complexities.

title.description: Title of the solution (e.g., 'Brute Force', 'Hash Map').

solution.description: Code for the solution in different programming languages (base64 encoded).

^(python|javascript|java|cpp|go|rust)$.description: Base64 encoded string of the solution code for a specific language.
